```{r expressom_custom_setup, include=FALSE}
.expressom_fig <- function(path, caption = "", required = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(path) || length(path) == 0 || !nzchar(path)) {
    if (required) {
      cat(sprintf("\n*Figure not provided: %s*\n\n", caption))
    }
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) {
      cat(sprintf("\n*Figure not found: `%s`*\n\n", path))
    }
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }

  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))

  if (ext %in% c("png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "svg")) {
    cat(sprintf("\n![%s](%s)\n\n", caption, path))
  } else {
    cat(
      sprintf(
        "\n[Download PDF: %s](%s)\n\n",
        if (nzchar(caption)) caption else basename(path),
        path
      )
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r expressom_custom_figures, results='asis'}
.expressom_fig(
  "{{PCA_FILE}}",
  "PCA plot",
  required = TRUE
)

.expressom_fig(
  "{{PCA_CORR_FILE}}",
  "PCA plot after batch correction",
  required = FALSE
)

.expressom_fig(
  "{{HEATMAP_FILE}}",
  "Sample correlation heatmap",
  required = TRUE
)

.expressom_fig(
  "{{VOLCANO_FILE}}",
  "Volcano plot",
  required = TRUE
)

.expressom_fig(
  "{{MA_FILE}}",
  "MA plot (shrunken)",
  required = TRUE
)
```
